reminder.title: Time for your Journey
reminder.body_direct: Your planned Step is ready. Open it now.
reminder.title_explanatory: It's time for your planned Step
reminder.body_explanatory: This reminder arrived at the time you chose. Open it when you're ready.
reminder.title_warm: A little reminder for what matters to you
reminder.body_warm: It's time for the Step you planned. We're here when you're ready.
reminder.body_energizing: The Step you planned is here. Let's get started.

allyRequest.title: New Support Circle request
allyRequest.body_direct: {{name}} asked to support you. Review it now.
allyRequest.body_explanatory: {{name}} would like to support one of your Journeys. Open the request to accept or decline.
allyRequest.title_warm: Someone would like to walk with you
allyRequest.body_warm: {{name}} asked to support you. Take a look and see if it feels right.
allyRequest.title_energizing: Your Support Circle may be growing
allyRequest.body_energizing: {{name}} wants to support you. Open the request and choose.

allyAccepted.title: You have a new Ally
allyAccepted.body_direct: They are now in your Support Circle.
allyAccepted.body_explanatory: {{name}} accepted your request and is now an Ally on that Journey.
allyAccepted.title_warm: You are not doing this alone
allyAccepted.body_warm: {{name}} said yes. They are with you on that Journey now.
allyAccepted.body_energizing: {{name}} is in. Your Support Circle just grew.

allyDeclined.title: Support Circle update
allyDeclined.body: {{name}} isn't able to join right now.
allyDeclined.body_explanatory: {{name}} is not able to join right now. You can ask someone else whenever you like.
allyDeclined.body_warm: {{name}} is not able to join right now. It says nothing about you, and there are other people you can ask.
allyDeclined.body_energizing: {{name}} is not joining this time. Someone else might be the right fit.

allyPermissionChanged.title: Sharing updated
allyPermissionChanged.body: {{name}} changed what they share with you.
allyPermissionChanged.body_direct: {{name}} changed what they share with you.
allyPermissionChanged.body_explanatory: They updated what you can see of their Journey. Open their profile for the current view.
allyPermissionChanged.body_warm: What you can see of their Journey has changed. That part is always theirs to decide.
allyPermissionChanged.body_energizing: {{name}} changed what you can see. Take a look.

allyRemoved.title: Support Circle update
allyRemoved.body_explanatory: They are no longer supporting that Journey. Nothing else about it has changed.
allyRemoved.body_warm: They are no longer supporting that Journey. People come and go, and the Journey is still yours.
allyRemoved.body_energizing: {{name}} stepped back from a Journey. Yours keeps going.

journeyFrozen.title: A Journey is on pause
journeyFrozen.body_direct: It is on hold for now.
journeyFrozen.body_explanatory: {{name}} paused a Journey you support. Nothing is lost; it continues when they resume.
journeyFrozen.body_warm: A Journey you support is on hold. A pause is part of it.
journeyFrozen.body_energizing: {{name}} paused a Journey. It will be there when they come back.

journeyResumed.title: A Journey is moving again
journeyResumed.body_explanatory: {{name}} picked a Journey back up, from where it stopped.
journeyResumed.body_warm: A Journey you support is moving again. A good moment for a word.
journeyResumed.body_energizing: A Journey you support is moving again. Cheer them on.

journeyCompleted.title: A Journey is complete
journeyCompleted.body: {{name}} reached the end of a Journey.
journeyCompleted.body_explanatory: {{name}} reached the end of a Journey you supported.
journeyCompleted.body_warm: A Journey you supported is complete. You were part of that.
journeyCompleted.body_energizing: A Journey you supported is complete. Send them something.

one.title: {{journeys}} is waiting
one.body: There is at least one Step still open. A small moment gets it moving.
one.body_direct: {{pendingStepCount}} Steps are open. You can start now.
one.body_explanatory: You asked us to choose the time, and this one looks right. {{pendingStepCount}} Steps are still open.
one.body_warm: This Journey is still here, and so are we. Whenever it suits you.
one.body_energizing: {{pendingStepCount}} Steps are waiting. Take one now.

many.title: {{journeyCount}} Journeys are waiting
many.body_explanatory: Rather than a reminder for each Journey, here they are together: {{journeys}}. {{pendingStepCount}} Steps are open.
many.title_warm: A few things that matter to you are waiting
many.body_warm: {{journeys}}. You do not need all of it today, one Step is enough.

center.title: Activity
center.empty: All quiet for now. When friends cheer you, need support, or send you a request, it will appear here.

kinds.allyInvite: {{name}} asked you to support a Journey
kinds.mirrorInvite: {{name}} asked what you see in them

bundles.encourager: You would see the progress, not the details
bundles.companion: You would see the progress and the steps
